data.name: Tower of Dew-Collecting
data.detailed_description:
This casual puzzle game features beautiful graphics that make up:

The Tower of Dew Collecting is located on the banks of the Yujiang River in Luancheng Town, Hengzhou City, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. It is situated in the southern subtropical monsoon climate zone and was first built in the 42nd year of the Ming Wanli reign (1614) by Tong Shiming, the magistrate of Yongchun County. During the Tongzhi reign, it was relocated to its current location and rebuilt into a seven story, eight sided brick tower with dense eaves. The tower has a total height of 39 meters and a base circumference of 29 meters. The couplet at the tower gate reads "The Yao Terrace outside the sky bears the jade dew, and the Qiong tree in the clouds rises the golden turtle". The tower underwent further renovation in the 22nd year of the Qing Dynasty's Daoguang reign (1842) but was not completed. In the 12th year of the Tongzhi reign (1873), it was relocated to Guishan for reconstruction due to the influence of the Li Wencai Uprising, costing 5000 guan and 349000 bricks. It also had the functions of flood control and feng shui suppression.

Game starts:

Click on 'start game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen

Game process:

Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small images move to the correct position, and the game ends

End or start the next game:

All the small fragments move to the correct position, and the game ends. At this point, click "try again" to repeat the game.
